messages:
sarah_sales: Quick thread — Acme's procurement needs an evidence bundle for the POC: SOC2 excerpt, ISO-style network diagram for staging (redacted), signed pen-test attestation, and the ability for their third-party scanner to run against staging. Also asked about isolated staging pricing.

ajay_se: Got it. For the external scan we prefer a short-lived window + presigned upload for results. Avoid sharing long-lived creds.

ajay_se: Presign example we can hand them: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/acme-poc/scan-results.zip --expires-in 86400`

maggie_compliance: We can provide SOC2 cover pages + scope + a redacted control map. No raw audit tickets or internal logs. Network diagram must omit hostnames and internal IPs.

maggie_compliance: Pen-test letter: we have a standard attestation template. It permits a one-time third-party assessment under NDA, monitored by us. We cannot guarantee no findings.

sarah_sales: Procurement says signatory needs company legal name + city in the block. Is that a problem?

legal-bot: Minor add of legal name + city is fine. Any changes that increase liability or promise results will require a full legal review (3-5 business days).

purchasing_acme: Confirming they'd like the scan outside business hours, ideally next week evening. Also need a ballpark for single-tenant staging for procurement review.

ajay_se: Evening is fine. For an isolated short-lived staging window we can absorb costs for the POC. Reserved single-tenant month -> roughly +25% on base rate. I'll get a formal quote from infra ops.

devops-bot: Kickoff: prepare-staging job started (id job-9021). Will publish staging IP and presign URL when ready.

ajay_se: Ops checklist for scanner: 1) NDA signed, 2) confirmed scan scope (hosts/ports), 3) presigned upload for reports, 4) schedule window and rotate any ephemeral creds.

maggie_compliance: Reminder: require NDA before sharing detailed findings. Our attestation references that — we won't hand over raw vuln reports without it.

sarah_sales: Action items: @purchasing_acme send any redline to the attestation, @ajay_se finalize presign + window, @maggie_compliance route to legal if they redline. I'll update procurement with the caveats and pricing ballpark. :thumbsup:

purchasing_acme: Sent a one-line redline: include "ACME Corp, San Jose" in the signatory. Nothing else.

legal-bot: Received. Routing — expect ok within 24-48h unless liability text added.

devops-bot: Staging ready: allowlist IP 3.101.22.77/32, presign link (24h): https://s3-redwood.example/presign/acme-poc/scan-results.zip?token=XXX (placeholder).

ajay_se: We'll log presign usage and archive reports after 30 days. If procurement needs longer retention we'll escalate.

sarah_sales: Thanks team — I'll close the loop once legal signs and I'll attach the final packet. Ping here for scope changes. :sparkles:
